criteria.intent: Deliver an editable 13-slide English edition with notes and the explicit 23+5+2 timing plan.
criteria.automated_scope: No generic repository check establishes slide count, English wording, actual note attachment or speaking duration. Record the exact PPTX relationship and note audit in the versioned review; rehearsal remains AC06.

criteria.intent: Retain the selected PMDay dimensions, native visuals and complete evidence slide, recording every visible change.
criteria.automated_scope: The selected upstream PPTX and derivative require an exact package comparison, including chart/workbook, tables, artwork and all visible text changes. The reports slide must differ only in pagination. These artifact observations are recorded separately; RI hashes do not prove reuse or semantic preservation.

criteria.intent: Independently review the SDLC equilibrium, cognitive delegation and sociotechnical narrative and every rendered slide.
criteria.automated_scope: Narrative quality, consistency with the English notes and all-slide readability require a recorded independent content and visual review of the exact candidate. Successful conversion, generic source checks and self-review do not supply that evidence.

criteria.intent: Commit matching review deliverables, mapping, notes, provenance and revision decisions in an issue-linked Draft PR.
criteria.automated_scope: Record the actual PPTX/PDF checksums and correspondence, selected source identity, per-item provenance, notes and visible-change mapping. Observe the committed files and live Draft PR linkage separately; the repository policy cannot create or verify a GitHub approval.

criteria.intent: Maintain the exact draft's path catalog, acceptance mapping, bounded checks, RI freshness and versioned handoff.
criteria.automated_scope: BASIC checks the existing site source/output contract without a new browser matrix. STYLE checks its declared source guard subset. CURRENT-RI verifies the complete catalog and fresh generated views; RI-CI verifies the unchanged workflow routes and mapped new policy. Review the exact draft-only diff, AC mapping and applicable CS01, CS02, CS04, CS05, CS08-CS10 separately. No builder, runtime, public site output, workflow or test budget changes are introduced.

criteria.intent: Obtain the author's review, timed rehearsal and presenting-device acceptance before designating a final conference edition.
criteria.automated_scope: Author acceptance, real speaking time and behavior on the presenting device are not established by local rendering or any repository check. Preserve them as pending until the author's exact-edition evidence is recorded.

ARTIFACT-REVIEW.description: Review exact source and derivative hashes, 13-slide order, editable native objects, internally attached English notes, 23+5+2 timing declaration and the exhaustive visible-change log. Compare all retained dimensions, diagrams, native tables, chart/workbook and artwork; prove the complete reports slide changes only its page number. Record the audit and its limits in review/issue-109/2026-10-19-review.md.

INDEPENDENT-REVIEW.description: Record independent content and all-slide visual review against the accepted SDLC equilibrium and cognitive-delegation framing. Check that operating-model proposals remain hypotheses, the complete reports slide is retained and English notes explain every selected slide. Identify the reviewer role, inspected artifact hashes, findings and dispositions; self-review is not independent acceptance.

DELIVERY-LINKAGE.description: Observe matching PPTX/PDF, source and rights/provenance records, source-to-derivative mapping, notes and revision decisions in a commit linked with Refs #109 and one Draft PR. Record exact file/commit links and separate preparation from public publication, merge or conference acceptance.

HANDOFF-REVIEW.description: Review the policy against all six unchanged issue109 criteria, draft-only file scope, source owners, readable JSON and the bounded CS01, CS02, CS04, CS05, CS08-CS10 obligations. Record fresh RI/coupling and exact-source check results, retained failures and actual issue checkbox reconciliation. Draft-deferred CI remains skipped, not passed; no site staging or production run is required for these repository-only deliverables.

AUTHOR-ACCEPTANCE.description: Record the author's review of this exact edition, timed rehearsal fitting the 30-minute slot including questions and reserve, and actual presenting-device acceptance before calling it the final DevCon conference edition. Preparing or pushing a Draft PR does not require this final-edition gate to be complete.
